item.title: Javascript Count Up to Number
item.description: This article explores the classic UI component that is the simple count up timer written in Javascript. Often used to help display statistics in a dynamic way.

item.title: Create an Accessible Vanilla Javascript Accordion
item.description: The accordion is a user interface component that helps structure and display website information through an expansion/contraction mechanism. This article explores building a vanilla javascript accordion with accessibility in mind.
